description: Feature flags (session 6f). New systems are built behind these and switched on together in the session's last stage. bikeDocks: scripts/generate-maps.mjs places the bike-share docks of the world dataset on the map (prop markers, collision, the 'docks' layer). riding: Action at a dock rents or returns a bike (src/scenes/MapScene.ts). speedButtons: the 0/1/2/3 speed buttons and keys.
